entities.summary: China Keitetsi is a Ugandan activist campaigning against the use of child soldiers. The memoirs of Keitetsi, a former child soldier herself, have been translated into French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Danish, Italian, Spanish, Dutch and other languages.
